columns.name: EVAL_PARTICIPANT_ID
columns.description: Primary key of the Participant

columns.name: BUSINESS_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS

columns.name: EVALUATION_ID
columns.description: Primary key of Evaluation.

columns.name: PERSON_ID
columns.description: The global ID of the person who is nominated as the participant

columns.name: EVAL_ROLE_ID
columns.description: Indicates the role type of the participant

columns.name: QUESTIONNAIRE_ID
columns.description: Stores the questionnaire for the participant

columns.name: ROLE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the code to identify the type of role (MANAGER, WORKER or PARTICIPANT)

columns.name: PARTICIPATION_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Stores the status of the participant.

columns.name: STATUS_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Stores the date when the participant status was last updated.

columns.name: DUE_DATE
columns.description: Stores the due date for the participant to provide the feedback

columns.name: ADDED_BY_PERSON_ID
columns.description: Stores the person_id who added the participant into the document

columns.name: ADDED_BY_ROLE
columns.description: Stores the role type code of who added the participant into the document

columns.name: NOTIFIED_FLAG
columns.description: Stores whether the participant was notified.

columns.name: NOTIFIED_BY_ROLE
columns.description: Stores which role sent the request notification to the participant.

columns.name: NOTIFIED_BY_PERSON_ID
columns.description: Stores the person_id who send request

columns.name: FDBACK_STARTED_FLAG
columns.description: Stores if the participant has started giving the feedback.

columns.name: FDBACK_SENT_BACK_FLAG
columns.description: Stores whether the participant feedback was sent back by the manager for rework.

columns.name: LOCKED_OUT_FLAG
columns.description: Stores whether the participant is locked out or not.

columns.name: LOCKED_OUT_DATE
columns.description: Stores the date on which the participant was locked out.

columns.name: FDBACK_COMPLETION_DATE
columns.description: Stores when the participant feedback was completed.

columns.name: PCPN_COMMENTS_FOR_WRK
columns.description: Stores the comments given by the participant that the worker can see.

columns.name: MATRIX_PARTICIPANT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates that role is matrix participant role.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: PCPN_COMMENT_TEXT_FOR_WRK
columns.description: Stores the comments given by the participant that the worker can see.

columns.name: ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Action Code for performing the action on the participant.

columns.name: ACTION_REASON
columns.description: Reason for performing the action on the participant.

columns.name: ACTION_PERFORMED_BY
columns.description: Stores the Person Id of the person performing the action.

columns.name: ACTION_PERFORMED_DATE
columns.description: Timestamp when the action was performed.
